Readiness = passing applicable gates / applicable gates * 100. Not the weighted model.
v3.4 s11; ELT precedence over ARB
false until a delegated AI CoE authority is bound; no trigger + false => PREPARATION lane
Named delegated approver principal. Blank => DECISION_AUTHORITY_KNOWN gate cannot pass.
ARB owner principal (Kelli/Clay path). Blank => gate cannot pass. ARB integration is NOT in MVP.
ELT decision body. Blank => gate cannot pass.
Set true only by ELT decision 2.
EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS gate: validated packets older than this fail.
DueAt offset for S2-S5 packets.
Overdue days before a reminder outbox row is written.
Overdue days before ESCALATION_REQUIRED event.
UAT only: RETURNED packets become VALIDATED with a provisional assertion. Set false before any real use.
Outbox: false => every QUEUED row is SUPPRESSED. Nothing is sent in UAT.
UPNs allowed to SubmitEvidenceResponse for any packet (in addition to AssignedPerson).
UPNs allowed to RequestDecisionReadiness / read any case (AI CoE operators). Empty => requester/owner/sponsor only.
Rows claimed per Case Command cycle.
A flow with no heartbeat inside this window is reported silent.
PENDING command rows older than this are reported.
